newsitem.title: USA: Simon & Schuster unit launches girls' CD-ROM.
newsitem.headline: Simon & Schuster unit launches girls' CD-ROM.

text.p: Simon & Schuster Inc's consumer software publishing unit said on Tuesday it will launch a new CD-ROM created for pre-teen and teenage girls.

The software called "Let's Talk About ME!", developed in conjunction with Girl Games Inc, uses a diary format and has the look of a magazine. Girl Games president and chief executive, Laura Groppe, said the message was "I am a girl, I am digital and I am cool."
With more than two years research behind the project, Groppe said the content and design "will tell you this is not your brother's software."
The CD-ROM covers the changes in a girl's developing body, includes interviews with 23 well-known and successful women and features quizzes, cyber-pals, fashion and horoscopes, the company said.
Simon & Schuster said the product was well-received in preliminary tests and will be available in stores in September in time for back-to-school sales.
